{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Target Spring XD on Spring Framework 6.x / Java 17+ stack as stated in the spec",
    "U1: Expose the Sqoop metastore location and JDBC connection through standard Spring Boot externalized configuration properties (no custom plumbing), and use Sqoop's built-in --meta-connect argument when launching the connector",
    "U2: Document the HDFS-backed module registry in the existing Spring XD reference documentation (AsciiDoc), focusing on recommended properties (spring.xd.module.registry.uri, replication, ZooKeeper vs. HDFS failover)",
    "U3: Add three new collection-level read endpoints (/metrics/counters/all, /metrics/gauges/all, /metrics/rich-gauges/all) reusing the existing MetricRepository, GaugeRepository, and RichGaugeRepository; return the same DTO already used by the per-name endpoints to stay consistent",
    "U4: Build a new Boot-based ModuleRunner as a Spring Boot application using spring-boot-starter that programmatically creates the same bus/module/launcher context the current Runner builds, with deployment properties injected for container-managed environments",
    "U5: Wire Spring Data GemFire's native security (security-client-auth-init, security-username, security-password, security-properties-file) into the existing GemFire source module, sourced from Spring configuration; document the required properties",
    "U6: Reuse the existing gpfdist client/sink code by extracting the writer into a shared library and consuming it from a new Spring Batch-oriented job (jdbcgpfdist) with a JDBC cursor reader and gpfdist writer as the step",
    "U7: Introduce a dedicated test infrastructure module/artifact that provides composition roots for in-memory repositories and clearly separates it from the real ZooKeeper/HDFS-backed production repositories, so tests depend on the abstraction not on the implementation",
    "U8: Move the spring-xd-reactor module from the spring-xd-modules repo into the core project as a new processor module, update Maven/Gradle module layout, and expose a Reactor Stream-based Processor API",

    "Documentation is delivered in the project's existing AsciiDoc reference format",

    "Existing module/sink code can be extracted/refactored without external API breakage to other consumers",
    "Code review and release coordination time covers the whole increment rather than per story",
    "Reference links in the user stories (Stack Overflow, SocialCast, JIRA) supply sufficient context and do not need stakeholder follow-up"
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",

    },

      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "U1 - Configurable Sqoop metastore",
      "activity_description": "Introduce configuration properties for metastore JDBC URL/driver/credentials, plumb them through to the Sqoop job launcher (--meta-connect), update integration tests, and document the new properties.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3.0
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "U2 - HDFS-backed module registry documentation",
      "activity_description": "Write a reference section explaining how to configure XD-2287's HDFS-backed module registry, including recommended properties, ZooKeeper interaction, and a working example; review and publish in the docs.",
      "most_likely_effort": 1.5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "U3 - Bulk REST API endpoints for metrics",
      "activity_description": "Add /metrics/counters/all, /metrics/gauges/all, and /metrics/rich-gauges/all controller methods, reuse existing repository calls and DTOs, add controller tests, and document the endpoints.",
      "most_likely_effort": 2.5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "U4 - Boot-based ModuleRunner",
      "activity_description": "Design a new ModuleRunnerApplication as a Spring Boot app, build the bus/module/launcher context programmatically, expose container-friendly configuration, package as a runnable jar, and add integration tests that deploy sample modules without xd-container.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6.0
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "U5 - GemFire source with native authentication",
      "activity_description": "Identify the security-related GemFire client properties, thread them through the GemFire source module configuration, add an integration test that authenticates against a secured locator, and document the required properties.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3.0
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "U6 - jdbcgpfdist OOTB batch job",
      "activity_description": "Refactor the existing gpfdist sink so the writer is reusable, implement a Spring Batch job with a JDBC cursor ItemReader and the gpfdist ItemWriter, register the job as an OOTB job, add unit and integration tests, and document usage.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6.0
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "U7 - Test infrastructure refactor (mocks vs. real repositories)",
      "activity_description": "Carve out a test-support module that provides in-memory repository implementations and Spring configuration for tests, decouple existing tests from ZooKeeper/HDFS-backed repositories, and verify the test suite still passes.",
      "most_likely_effort": 2.0
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "U8 - Move reactor data processor module to core",
      "activity_description": "Migrate the spring-xd-reactor module from the spring-xd-modules repo into the core project (build files, package layout, dependencies), wire it into the core build, expose Reactor Stream-based Processor API, and add tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4.0
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "End-to-end integration testing",
      "activity_description": "Run cross-story integration scenarios (e.g., Boot-based Runner deploying a GemFire source + reactor processor, metrics endpoints reporting activity, jdbcgpfdist job running on the cluster) and fix regressions found.",
      "most_likely_effort": 3.0
    },
    {

    }
  ],

    "most_likely_effort": 37.5
  }
